summary: Play four familiar logic games offline.
page_description: Four hundred and twenty offline puzzles across four logic games, graded from Starter to Hard, with the same controls in every game, separate progress and undo.
release_notes: 420 puzzles graded Starter to Hard, a puzzle list you can filter by grade, Minesweeper fields you can clear without guessing, and Rules, Undo and New game in the same place in every game.
